screening.reason: Exclusion 3: uses only structural MRI (T1-weighted corpus callosum and intracranial brain volume features) from ABIDE-I, with no resting-state functional connectivity analysis.

evidence_quotes: This study is performed using structural MRI (s-MRI) scans from Autism Brain Imaging Data Ex- change (ABIDE-I) dataset (http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide/abide_I.html).
Corpus callosum and intracranial brain volume data is obtained from T1-weighted MRI scans.
